lines.say: switches on GLP-1 receptors: more insulin, less glucagon when blood sugar is high
stomach emptying slows, which can change warfarin absorption, so INR is checked
in type 2 diabetes, HbA1c about 0.7 to 1.1 points lower than placebo
fewer heart attacks, strokes and cardiovascular deaths in type 2 diabetes: 12.0% vs 13.4%
about 2 to 3 kg more weight lost than placebo or insulin (not approved for weight loss)
kidney function checked in kidney disease if vomiting or diarrhea is severe
boxed warning: thyroid C-cell tumors in rats; unknown in humans
acute pancreatitis, rarely in bleeding or tissue-destroying forms that can be fatal
gallstones and gallbladder inflammation, a label warning
low blood sugar is more likely with insulin or a sulfonylurea, so it's checked
nausea in 12% to 21% versus 5% on placebo, plus diarrhea, vomiting and stomach pain
